prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and desired services. I can help you find the best match, but first here are practical ways to decide and next steps.

How to choose the right agency
- Define your primary goals: lead generation (B2B), e‑commerce revenue, brand awareness, or local foot traffic.
- Match services to goals: SEO & content for organic growth, PPC for fast lead acquisition, social & creative for brand/engagement, marketing automation for B2B nurture.
- Look for relevant experience: case studies or clients in your industry, similar project scope, measurable results.
- Check transparency & reporting: clear KPIs, reporting cadence, access to dashboards.
- Confirm tech & certifications: Google Ads/Bing/Meta certifications, analytics expertise, CRM integrations.
- Team fit & communication: a dedicated account manager, response times, and cultural fit with your team.
- Budget and contract terms: monthly retainer vs project/fee-for-service, minimums, cancellation terms.
- References and ROI: ask for references and examples of measurable outcomes (cost per lead, sales lift, traffic growth).

Questions to ask any agency
- Have you worked with companies in our industry or of our size?
- Can you share case studies with metrics (cost per lead, conversion rate, ROI)?
- What will success look like after 3, 6, 12 months?
- Who will work on our account and how often will we meet?
- What tools and platforms do you use, and what access will we have?
- How do you price services and what are contract terms?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 3–5 St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs (SEO, PPC, B2B, e‑commerce) — tell me: your goals, monthly budget, industry, and whether you prefer local or remote agencies.
- Draft an RFP or a shortlist of interview questions for agencies.

Which would you prefer?
